business_scope.primary_industry_name: Maritime Seafarer Staffing and Vessel Crew Management Agency

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France-Germany Double Taxation Agreement (1959, as amended)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier) Articles L.561-1 to L.561-45 and R.561-1 to R.561-17, including Article L.561-2-2 on the Beneficial Owner Register; Decree No. 2018-284 of 18 April 2018 implementing the UBO register; French Law No. 2022-1514 of 16 December 2022 strengthening anti-fraud and AML/CFT obligations; INPI regulatory instructions for the RCS filing and UBO declaration.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate charter or notarized articles of association of each corporate shareholder or UBO entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent consolidated company registry or notary in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where applicable; otherwise Consular Legalization by the French Embassy or Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and good standing certificate for each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent commercial registry in the country of origin (e.g., Companies House, U.S. Secretary of State, ACRA)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where applicable; otherwise Consular Legalization by the French Embassy or Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of valid passport and proof of residential address for each manager and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National authority or notary in the relevant country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where applicable; otherwise Consular Legalization by the French Embassy or Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Judicial record extract or equivalent police clearance certificate for each proposed manager (gérant) and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Criminal records authority in the person's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where applicable; otherwise Consular Legalization by the French Embassy or Consulate

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the UN Security Council Sanctions List, and the French Treasury asset-freeze lists (listes de gel d'avoirs) before onboarding. OFAC SDN screening is also recommended for USD wire, correspondent banking, and sanctions alignment. Enhanced due diligence is statutorily required for all politically exposed persons (PEPs) pursuant to Article L.561-10 of the French Monetary and Financial Code. Screening must be repeated at onboarding, upon any change in shareholding or management, and at least annually thereafter.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Infogreffe (Registre National du Commerce et des Sociétés) and the INPI Guichet Unique portal at https://guichet-entreprises.gouv.fr
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All statutory filings, including the corporate name, must be submitted in French; where the proposed name contains foreign words or scripts, it must be transliterated into Latin characters and, if necessary, accompanied by a certified French translation prepared by a sworn translator. The name must not be misleading with reference to the object clause and must include the legal form suffix 'SARL'.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name clearance is refused by the competent clerk (greffier) or the INPI agent, the applicant may, within 15 days of notification of the refusal, file an urgent motion (référé) before the President of the Commercial Court having jurisdiction over the registered office; the court may order the registry clerk to complete the registration or impose such measures as necessary. A further appellate remedy lies before the Court of Appeal. If the rejection is based on a conflicting earlier registrable right, such as a trademark or existing company name, a negotiation or an action for revocation/nullity under Articles L.711-1 and L.714-5 of the French Intellectual Property Code is required in parallel.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual and domiciliation offices are accepted initially; a SARL may be domiciled at the manager's private home or an approved domiciliation provider for administrative purposes under Article L.223-10 of the French Commercial Code. However, for a licensed crew recruitment agency operating under French maritime and labour regulations, a fully virtual office without any physical presence will not be permissible after licensing; the agency must evidence a verifiable operational place of business, employment records, and interview facilities for seafarers where directed by the maritime authorities.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 25% to 35% annual risk of an unannounced physical inspection by the relevant service of the French Maritime Administration or the local labour inspectorate once the recruitment agency license is granted; the probability rises to 50% in the first 12 months after issuance.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 governing the Société à Responsabilité Limitée (SARL); procedural rules from Décret n° 2024-184, implemented via the national one-stop shop formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) having jurisdiction over the registered office, acting as registrar of the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Association (Statuts) together with the standard M0 incorporation declaration (déclaration de création d'entreprise) filed via the Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital for a French SARL; the articles may fix the capital from EUR 1 upwards. All cash contributions must be paid up in full at incorporation and blocked on a dedicated escrow or deposit account (compte bloqué) with a credit institution, Caisse des Dépôts or a notary; funds are released to the company only upon RCS registration (Code de commerce, Article L.223-7).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: First Board Resolution. The founder(s) hereby resolve: (1) adoption of the Articles of Association signed this day; (2) ratification of share capital subscription and receipt of the blocked account certificate confirming full payment of cash contributions under Article L.223-7 of the Commercial Code; (3) establishment of the registered office at the address stated in the articles; (4) appointment of the first gérant for an indefinite term; (5) authorisation to publish the legal notice and to submit the M0 declaration and all annexes to the RCS; (6) delegation of authority to complete the maritime crew recruitment licence procedure and to open the company bank account. Resolved and effective from signature.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the Articles of Association (Statuts SARL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founders acting under private signature (sous seing privé), or a notary where the contribution includes immovable property; no prior administrative authorization required
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the French-language statuts containing corporate name, registered office, corporate object limited to maritime crew recruitment and vessel crew management, share capital and distribution, appointment of the gérant, decision-making rules and maximum duration of 99 years. Each founding partner must sign every page and the final signature page; the deed must be issued in at least two originals.
required_dossiers: Copy of a valid identity document for each founder
Proof of registered office address or domiciliation agreement
Draft Articles of Association
Written acceptance of appointment signed by the first gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry queries the corporate object or the valuation of contributions, amend the statuts by an addendum or convene an extraordinary partner meeting to correct the deed before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of the blocked capital deposit account and full payment of cash contributions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any French credit institution, Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, or notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary escrow account in the name of the SARL in formation; deposit the full cash contributions equal to the subscribed capital; obtain the attestation du dépositaire des fonds stating the amount blocked, the account holder and the depositary; the certificate is released to the company only upon presentation of the RCS registration certificate.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association
Pro-forma invoice of registration costs
Identity documents of the founders
Proof of the gérant's identity and address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses account opening, invoke the droit au compte procedure before the Banque de France to designate a bank; alternatively, deposit the capital with a notary acting as depositary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the legal formation notice in a legal announcements gazette (JAL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Controleur of the Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL) authorized in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish the standard notice containing corporate name, legal form, share capital, registered office, corporate object and duration; obtain the attestation de parution; publication must occur between the signing of the statuts and the RCS filing.
required_dossiers: Signed founders' statement containing the publication data
Proof of payment of publication fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If publication is delayed or contains substantive errors, issue a corrective republication in the same authorized gazette and re-attest the legal notice date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of the incorporation file to the one-stop shop and the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via the national online portal formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the standard M0 declaration online; attach the executed statuts, the blocked deposit certificate, the JAL publication certificate, the DPAE (Déclaration Préalable à l'Embauche) and identification documents of the gérant; pay the registry fee; the Greffe performs legal conformity screening and registers the company in the RCS.
required_dossiers: Articles of Association in original and one certified copy
Blocked deposit certificate (attestation du dépositaire des fonds)
Legal announcement certificate (attestation de parution)
Fully completed M0 declaration form
DPAE signed and dated by the gérant
Identity document of the gérant
Proof of physical registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe issues observations or a request for complement, supply the missing documents within the prescribed deadline; alternatively, file a rectification or re-submit the M0 declaration with a covering letter explaining the corrections.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issue of the RCS registration certificate (extrait K-bis) and post-registration formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon acceptance, the Greffe issues the K-bis extract evidencing legal existence with SIREN, SIRET and APE/NAF identifiers; the blocked capital is automatically released to the company; the INSEE, tax and social authorities are notified through the one-stop shop; collect the K-bis and open the operational bank account.
required_dossiers: K-bis extract delivered ex officio
Registration number and acknowledgement of receipt of the M0 filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If delivery of the K-bis is delayed, obtain an interim certificate from the Greffe and, if necessary, petition the President of the Commercial Court for an order compelling issuance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for the maritime crew recruitment agency licence (agrément) and occupational workplace clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Direction des Affaires Maritimes (DAM) / Direction interrégionale de la Mer (DIRM) of the French maritime administration, coordinated with the Direction Régionale de l'Économie, de l'Emploi, du Travail et des Solidarités (DREETS) for private placement supervision
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After RCS registration, file the licence application with the competent DIRM, demonstrating compliance with the Maritime Labour Convention 2006, Regulation 1.4, technical and financial capacity, good repute of the gérant, and anti-corruption safeguards covering seafarer recruitment fees; submit fire safety and occupational health attestations, the DUERP, and premises compliance documents. The licence is issued where the authority is satisfied as to lawfulness of the operation.
required_dossiers: K-bis extract (extrait RCS)
Formal application for the agrément d'agence de placement des gens de mer
Certificate of non-conviction (bulletin n° 2) of the gérant and directors
Curriculum vitae and professional qualifications of management
Professional indemnity insurance certificate
DUERP and fire safety attestation
Declaration of premises and planned operational procedures
Proof of compliance with MLC 2006 requirements on crew recruitment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is declared incomplete, exercise the right to supplement within the imposed delay; if refused, lodge a recours gracieux with the Minister in charge of maritime affairs within two months, followed, if necessary, by an action before the administrative court.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction des Affaires Maritimes (DAM) / Direction interrégionale de la Mer (DIRM) of the French Ministry of Ecological Transition and Territorial Cohesion, acting through the Secrétariat d'État chargé de la Mer, in coordination with DREETS (Ministry of Labour, Employment and Economic Inclusion) for private employment placement control
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Agrément d'Agence Privée de Recrutement et de Placement des Gens de Mer (Private Seafarer Recruitment and Placement Agency Licence) — governed by the Code des transports provisions on maritime labour (Book V of Maritime Transport) and by the Maritime Labour Convention 2006, Regulation 1.4

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) of the Ministry of Ecological Transition and Territorial Cohesion; where applicable, the installation may fall under the Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement (ICPE) regime
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — non-ICPE administrative and professional services activity; no mandatory environmental impact assessment, environmental authorization, or prior environmental registration is required for a seafarer recruitment and crew management back-office, unless substantial physical facilities are later developed
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not subject to industrial discharge or VOC emission thresholds; as standard obligations, office wastewater must comply with municipal sewer by-laws, business waste (déchets d'activités économiques) must be sorted and disposed through approved carriers under Articles L.541-1 et seq. of the Environmental Code, and any office fit-out must satisfy RE2020 energy performance regulations

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: stamp issued by the Commission de sécurité or a fire safety attestation for tertiary premises accessible by employees or the public; structure: attestation of building regulatory compliance where the office undergoes fit-out or change of use; occupational health: validated DUERP (Document Unique d'Évaluation des Risques Professionnels), registration with workplace health services, and documented training for crew travel safety and emergency procedures

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – impots.gouv.fr; corporate entity reporting via formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must file a registration notice with the DGFiP's Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) for the entity's registered office or permanent establishment in France. The application requires corporate constitutional documents, proof of the foreign parent company's existence, a French address for the establishment or a designated fiscal representative for non-residents, and a description of the planned French business activities. Upon approval, the SIE issues a French tax identification number (numéro d'identification), which is distinct from the SIREN/SIRET numbers, and, where applicable, the company is also registered for VAT and homologated for the French VAT identification number (TVA intracommunautaire) via the EU VAT Information Exchange System.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: SARL is subject to corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés) by default; it may elect for fiscal transparency as a société de personnes under Article 239 bis AA of the French General Tax Code (CGI) for eligible small/medium enterprises meeting shareholder and turnover criteria. Group taxation (intégration fiscale) is available under Articles 223 A et seq. CGI for 95%-owned French subsidiaries; VAT grouping election under Article 267 bis CGI is available for French-established entities.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (TVA – Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No registration threshold for non-established suppliers of B2B services; VAT registration is mandatory from the first taxable supply in France. For domestic micro-businesses, the franchise en base threshold is EUR 91,900 (goods) / EUR 36,800 (services), but this does not apply to foreign entities supplying ship crew recruitment services. For distance selling of goods by EU suppliers, the French threshold is EUR 35,000, and EUR 10,000 for cross-border B2C electronic services; ship crew recruitment is a B2B service subject to reverse charge unless the customer is a French-established shipowner, in which case the foreign supplier must register and charge French VAT.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France mandates structured electronic invoicing for all VAT-registered businesses in phases commencing 1 September 2026 (and from 1 September 2027 for large enterprises). Invoices must be issued in a structured XML or EDI format, transmitted through a registered Dematerialisation Partner Platform (PDP), and reported to the DGFiP. Real-time fiscal clearance and digital stamping are not currently in force; however, mandatory e-reporting of transaction data (e-reporting) to the tax authority will be implemented, and pre-existing anti-fraud data transmission requirements apply to certain high-risk supplies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating for exports of goods outside the EU applies under Article 262 CGI, requiring evidence that goods left French and EU territory within mandated time limits. For services, including crew recruitment, zero-rating may be claimed where the place of supply is outside France or where the service is directly linked to transportation of goods/persons or related to tangible movable property that is genuinely exported outside the EU by the supplier's customer. For ship crew recruitment to a non-EU shipowner or for services supplied to vessels engaged in international navigation, the supply can be zero-rated if the service recipient is established outside France and receives the benefit for the vessel's commercial use outside the EU. Documentary proof of the customer's non-EU establishment and the vessel's operating routes is required.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAU/EXS) transmitted via DELTA-X
Bill of Lading (B/L), air waybill, CMR, or other transport document evidencing shipment outside France/EU
Commercial invoice, signed crew placement contract, inward remittance certificate or bank transfer proof of payment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or unjustified zero-rating claims expose the taxpayer to immediate VAT reassessment, denial of the deduction/refund, plus a 40% penalty for deliberate misstatement, 80% penalty for abuse of rights or failure to file returns, and 100% penalty for manoeuvres frauduleuses, together with late interest at 0.20% per month on unpaid VAT. Criminal sanctions may reach up to EUR 500,000 fines and 5 years' imprisonment for tax fraud under Article 1741 CGI. The tax authority may withdraw VAT registration retroactively and claw back all zero-rated supplies with a mandatory minimum penalty regime.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France operates a regime of full current account convertibility for trade, services, and profit remittances. Capital account transactions require prior declaration to the Banque de France for amounts exceeding €100,000 per year. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are permitted following corporate tax clearance and beneficial ownership verification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender of export proceeds applies under current French FX regulations. All foreign exchange transactions must be reported to the Banque de France via the Système Economique de Déclaration des Opérations de Change (SEDOC) if exceeding reporting thresholds. Export receipts from maritime services require prompt repatriation supported by commercial invoices and shipping documents for tax and AML compliance.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: EMI cross-border operations in France are feasible under ACPR oversight but subject to strict passporting requirements and capital adequacy rules. Offshore digital EMIs face legal constraints due to the need for local licensing or equivalent compliance for payment services.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors and authorized signatories must appear physically for KYC interviews and onboarding at the bank branch, as remote opening is not permitted for corporate accounts in France.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Proof of non-sanctioned status, source of funds, and enhanced due diligence documents including beneficial ownership certificates
Corporate documents, share certificates, and notarized declarations

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections must be routed via SWIFT wire transfers using IBAN accounts with purpose code 'EQUITY CONTRIBUTION' or 'CAPITAL INJECTION'. Verification requires supporting documentation including board resolutions, share subscription agreements, and tax residency proofs. All transactions subject to AML screening and FX reporting to Banque de France.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for crew recruitment services use SWIFT MT103 messages with appropriate purpose codes such as 'SHIP CREW RECRUITMENT FEES'. Commercial Letters of Credit (LCs) are permissible for larger settlements involving international counterparties.
